title: Keep schema claims synchronized
statement: When changing session-learning schema or compatibility semantics, update every linked runtime reference and add a consistency assertion so installed guidance cannot disagree about the current schema or migration support.
anti_pattern: updating schema code and one compatibility reference while leaving another linked runtime reference stale
safe_path: search every linked runtime reference for schema, version, and migration claims
update all current-schema and compatibility statements together
add or run a consistency assertion against runtime constants before release
